objective: Verify observable behaviour of Applywright against its own gates and its end-to-end browser journey, and report exactly what ran, what passed and what did not run.

tasks.brief: Later mission only: this spec is not dispatched by the initial intake. From the explicit Applywright root, inspect source and scratch/runtime isolation before running node --test tests/, node --test server/lib server/provider, and node scripts/check.js under fresh resource/shared-heavy-lock admission. Use only approved named runtime variables with model/billing keys disabled for fixtures; never read/echo credentials, env/auth files or other-process argv/env. Run scripts/e2e-flow.mjs ONLY after current source/safety review and explicit browser/seat admission covering its headless Chrome temporary profile and external public job-board reads. An existing denial stays HOLD; no alternate raw CDP/harness workaround. Otherwise report E2E NOT RUN with the exact reason. Preserve the live site, apps, WSL, PM2 and data/. Report exact commands/exits/pass/fail/skip totals and artifact hashes; historical counts are not expected outputs. No writes to source/ledger, merge, publish or delegation; scratch artifacts outside the repo only. You are not alone in the codebase: preserve all changes. No Claude or live model/API call.
acceptance: Each of the four commands has its actual summary lines quoted.
The E2E run reports steps and assertions, and the commit it ran against.
Every failure includes the failing assertion text.
A NOT RUN section exists, even if empty, stating why.
No repository files modified; no delegation.
